# R5.16b — finite_manifest_contrast routing (leg b of the `aa196851` SPLIT — seq 185a)

**Summary.** Routes the R5.16 `finite_manifest_contrast` estimator into
the already-fixed analysis/report machinery (Packet D D.2 owner map:
persisted report → hh-analysis): `AnalysisSpec.kind` resolution,
`AnalysisInput.view` fold, `AnalysisError::Contrast`, `record_kind`
member, hh-embed strict integer decode. The estimator contract —
`hharness_eval::finite_manifest` + `IntervalMethod::
FiniteManifestContrast` landed seq 185 (PR #229) — is consumed
**UNCHANGED**; no second estimator, no divergent payload. Ticket
`docs/tickets/185a_R5.16b__beta-routing.md` (seq 185a); split-review
record `docs/build/planning/2026-11-02_R5.16b-split-review.md`. The
routing was written pre-split (checkpoint `13c0c9d4`) and moved out of
leg (a) by drop commit `ee421453`; this leg recovers it **verbatim** —
the landed leg-(a) contract diffed byte-identical to the checkpoint's,
so zero adjustment was needed.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-analysis/src/kernel.rs` (+142) — `AnalysisInput.view:
  Option<&ExperimentView>` (records-in — the caller folds the bound
  experiment's durable events; `None` for non-consuming kinds); the
  metadata-only gate (a declared `FiniteManifestContrast` method on a
  kind that does not compute it refuses — never a silent decoration);
  the `finite_manifest_contrast` kind arm: declared prior-name decode
  (pooled/hierarchical names → `PooledSubstitute`, unparseable →
  `UnknownMethod`), missing view → `MissingSpecRef`, `planned_
  population(view, runs, tasks, metric, pins)` → `finite_manifest_
  contrast(pop, decl)` → body member.
- `crates/hh-analysis/src/error.rs` (+12) — `AnalysisError::Contrast(
  ContrastError)` + `Display` + `From` — the same refusal vocabulary,
  never a second rule.
- `crates/hh-analysis/src/report.rs` (+1) — `record_kind` member
  `finite_manifest_contrast`.
- `crates/hh-embed/src/analysis_ops.rs` (+59/−17) — bound-experiment
  `bound_eid` resolution hoisted for reuse (the −17 are the same loop
  moved out of `post_amendment` — routing glue only, semantics
  identical); `experiment_view` folded from the bound run's durable
  events for the contrast kind (unbound/mixed → `None` → kernel
  refuses); strict integer decode — present-but-non-integer
  `confidence_ppm`/`resampling_draws`/`seed` → `SchemaViolation`,
  never a silent default.
- `crates/hh-analysis/tests/r5_16.rs` (new, 4 checks),
  `crates/hh-embed/tests/r5_16.rs` (new, 1 check); four
  `AnalysisInput.view = None` fixture sites (`hh-analysis` kernel/s5_3/
  s5_4, `hh-embed` s3_12b).
- Zero new event classes, zero dependencies (`hharness-experiment`/
  `hharness-eval` already deps), no schema/wire change.
